design-bot: Ticket created DES-4999, priority=high, ETA=24h.
Ari: Lead routing: paid -> SDR-paid queue; organic -> nurture sequence. HubSpot form id=ws_jun24_99, webhook=/hooks/webinar. Include utm_content=v1|v2|v3.
Theo: Engagement ops: pin signup link on X, 1 reply at +15m with testimonial, product lead reply at +2h.
Maya: Jess will draft 3 short testimonials and the social_blurb (1-line stat + CTA). Drop in copy doc.
ops-bot: Scheduler drafts created: teaser_x id=tx_1102 schedule=2024-06-11T15:00:00Z; linkedin id=ln_5505 schedule=2024-06-12T19:00:00Z
Maya: Great. If design hits ETA, we ship teaser tomorrow AM PT. :rocket:
